mentions.name: Priorities-aligned todo app
mentions.description: A personal priorities app, at its core a todo list, that runs items through a local LLM to reconcile them against declared (and occasionally derived) priorities and check alignment, so the most aligned items are the ones to act on.
mentions.source_excerpt: the most amusing one so far a priorities app. At its core its basically a todo list. The difference is that I let it go through local llm to reconcile against declared ( and occasionally derived ) priorities and check for alignment to the todo list with the idea being that the most aligned items should be the ones to act on.
